town_intro_sharps_lines_0.text: Lil Blunt. Come in off the street. Mind the glass. This is what the river wants.
town_intro_sharps_lines_0.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_1.text: A Sharps, Model 1874. The buffalo hunters called her the Buffalo Gun.
town_intro_sharps_lines_1.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_3.text: Thirty-inch octagon barrel, double set triggers, a tang sight you can read at six hundred yards.
town_intro_sharps_lines_3.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_4.text: Set the back trigger and the front one breaks at a whisper. Take a look. Don't take her home yet.
town_intro_sharps_lines_4.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_5.text: three coin and she is yours, cartridges by the box. Coin, never credit.
town_intro_sharps_lines_5.speaker: rich

town_intro_gatling_after_1.text: She stays on the post, Lil Blunt. When the river comes you will want her near the bank.
town_intro_gatling_after_1.speaker: rich

town_trade_00.text: You found the lane. Most don't.
town_trade_00.speaker: rich

town_trade_01.text: Rich? Inferno said you know this town.
town_trade_01.speaker: lil_blunt

town_trade_02.text: Iron's on the wall. Coin's the only tongue I take.
town_trade_02.speaker: rich

town_trade_04.text: Set trigger. It reaches clean across the water.
town_trade_04.speaker: rich

town_trade_06.text: Lead's sold by the box. It never comes cheap and it never comes free.
town_trade_06.speaker: rich

town_trade_08.text: That don't spend here. Bring the coin you earned.
town_trade_08.speaker: rich

town_trade_10.text: Mind the lane on the way out.
town_trade_10.speaker: rich

town_trade_12.text: And bring it back empty. That's how I know it worked.
town_trade_12.speaker: rich

town_trade_13.text: I'll take a look. Let's hear what you've got.
town_trade_13.speaker: lil_blunt

town_trade_14.text: Much obliged. I'll make it count.
town_trade_14.speaker: lil_blunt

town_greet_clerk_0.text: Morning, traveler. Keep your papers dry.
town_greet_clerk_0.speaker: clerk

town_greet_clerk_1.text: Claim office is down the boardwalk, partner.
town_greet_clerk_1.speaker: clerk

town_greet_oldtimer_0.text: Take it easy. This town ain't going anywhere.
town_greet_oldtimer_0.speaker: oldtimer

town_greet_oldtimer_1.text: Mind the dust. It gets into everything.
town_greet_oldtimer_1.speaker: oldtimer

town_greet_rancher_0.text: Fine day to be on your feet, partner.
town_greet_rancher_0.speaker: rancher

town_greet_rancher_1.text: Watch the horses round the bend.
town_greet_rancher_1.speaker: rancher

town_greet_dressmaker_0.text: Morning. Mind that loose stitch on your sleeve.
town_greet_dressmaker_0.speaker: dressmaker

town_greet_dressmaker_1.text: A little dust never hurt good cloth.
town_greet_dressmaker_1.speaker: dressmaker

town_greet_lady_0.text: Well now, a new face. Welcome to town.
town_greet_lady_0.speaker: lady

town_greet_lady_1.text: Best keep an ear out round the saloon.
town_greet_lady_1.speaker: lady

town_greet_bald_worker_0.text: Good day. Plenty of work before sundown.
town_greet_bald_worker_0.speaker: bald_worker

town_greet_bald_worker_1.text: Boardwalk's solid. Boots'll last longer on it.
town_greet_bald_worker_1.speaker: bald_worker

town_greet_grandma_0.text: There you are, dear. Stay out of trouble.
town_greet_grandma_0.speaker: grandma

town_greet_grandfather_0.text: Easy does it, son. No need to hurry.
town_greet_grandfather_0.speaker: grandfather

town_greet_grandfather_1.text: Good weather. Best enjoy it while it lasts.
town_greet_grandfather_1.speaker: grandfather

town_greet_grandmother_0.text: Lovely to see somebody new about town.
town_greet_grandmother_0.speaker: grandmother

town_greet_grandmother_1.text: Rest those feet when you get the chance.
town_greet_grandmother_1.speaker: grandmother

town_greet_youth_1.text: Stay sharp round here. Folks notice things.
town_greet_youth_1.speaker: youth

town_greet_boy_0.text: Hi there! Want to see how high I can jump?
town_greet_boy_0.speaker: boy

town_greet_boy_1.text: Watch me! I almost made it that time.
town_greet_boy_1.speaker: boy

town_greet_braided_girl_1.text: Bet you can't skip as quick as me.
town_greet_braided_girl_1.speaker: braided_girl

town_greet_bob_girl_1.text: Just one more turn, then it's your go.
town_greet_bob_girl_1.speaker: bob_girl

town_boardwalk.prompt: One pair of leather boot footsteps on an old timber boardwalk, natural short wooden taps with a slight plank creak. Close dry realistic foley, no voice, no wind, no bell, no music.

town_intro_sharps_lines_2.text: Falling block. One shot, then you earn the next one.
town_intro_sharps_lines_2.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_call_0.text: Now the one that is not for sale. Follow me out front.
town_intro_gatling_call_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_lines_0.text: Colt Gatling Gun. Six barrels, a drum on top, a crank on the side.
town_intro_gatling_lines_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_lines_1.text: Doctor Gatling's patent, built by Colt. Turn the crank and the barrels turn with it. Watch the plates.
town_intro_gatling_lines_1.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_after_0.text: Bolted to the porch. Not for coin, not for gold. Rich will not sell her and I will not let him.
town_intro_gatling_after_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_after_2.text: Go on. Take the crank. Short bursts. The drum is all there is.
town_intro_gatling_after_2.speaker: utah

town_intro_closing_0.text: Steady hands. Remember her when the shipment comes down.
town_intro_closing_0.speaker: utah

town_trade_03.text: River rises tomorrow. Something rides it down.
town_trade_03.speaker: utah

town_trade_05.text: From the high rocks you'll see the whole bend. Take the high rocks.
town_trade_05.speaker: utah

town_trade_07.text: Skiff's sound, crates are sealed. She'll ride wet and ride heavy.
town_trade_07.speaker: utah

town_trade_09.text: Come back when the purse sits heavier.
town_trade_09.speaker: utah

town_trade_11.text: Be on the overlook by first light. I'll be at the water.
town_trade_11.speaker: utah

vo_sheriff_1.text: Well now. Somebody rode in on Inferno's quad and lived. What can I do for you, partner?
vo_sheriff_1.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_2.text: Certificates are the Minister's department. Minister Mike Dean, this young fella wants one.
vo_sheriff_2.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_3.text: Till then, wet your whistle at the saloon across the street. And mind who's watching when you pay.
vo_sheriff_3.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_witness.text: Hold it. If this is happening, it happens proper. I'm the little fella's witness. Square up. Listen for the town bell. Nobody draws till that bell rings.
vo_sheriff_witness.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_foul.text: I said wait for the bell. Again.
vo_sheriff_foul.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_win.text: That settles it. The map's yours, son. Fair and square, and I saw it.
vo_sheriff_win.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_lose.text: Too slow. On your feet. Listen for the bell, and we'll do it again.
vo_sheriff_lose.speaker: sheriff

town_jail_00.text: Here he is. Caught him holding the gate open for the bears.
town_jail_00.speaker: sheriff

town_jail_01.text: All I did was open a gate. Somebody paid me to bring them in.
town_jail_01.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_03.text: Never saw a face. Coin, and an order: soften the claims before the vault locks.
town_jail_03.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_04.text: They want Fort Knox first. Watch the lake outflow, the river... the trains.
town_jail_04.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_05.text: Find who brought the bears, Lil Blunt. I'll keep this one where he is.
town_jail_05.speaker: sheriff

town_job_04.text: Rich and Utah. I'm on it, Sheriff.
town_job_04.speaker: lil_blunt

town_bullback_00.text: Heard that Gatling clear across town. Figured it had to be you, little man.
town_bullback_00.speaker: inferno

town_bullback_01.text: Come on. First whiskey's on me.
town_bullback_01.speaker: inferno

town_body_02.text: So who put a hole in his head?
town_body_02.speaker: inferno

town_body_03.text: Must've been a bird that had to get rid of the heavy load.
town_body_03.speaker: lil_blunt

town_drinks_01.text: To the quickest little hand in GoldMine.
town_drinks_01.speaker: inferno

town_drinks_03.text: Listen, my cousin Flux needs a hand with his new kettle.
town_drinks_03.speaker: inferno

town_drinks_04.text: We'll lie low a little while and meet up later. Stay out of trouble.
town_drinks_04.speaker: inferno
